utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what repairs are we collecting for first, and who’s keeping the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the order yet, Mina, but I can ask around while I’m out. If no one’s keeping the list, I’ll find out who should be.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—ask today if you can, and tell me who has the list by this evening.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I’m glad you’re organizing the repair drive—if folks need drills, clamps, or a spare workbench, I can bring mine over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus—that’s really helpful. I’ll put you down for drills, clamps, and the workbench, unless I forget where I put the list again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Noah—I’ll bring the drills, clamps, and workbench, and I’ll remind you again before the drive so it doesn’t get lost in the shuffle.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Pia, have you heard the latest about the repair drive? I’m trying to get the details straight before I start telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ve only heard bits, Tess, and I’d rather not spread anything until we know the time, drop-off spot, and who’s handling the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s sensible, Pia — I’ll check with the organizers first and won’t pass anything along until we’ve got the time, drop-off spot, and tool person confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Opal, I heard you’re organizing the repair drive—how can I help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Sam, thanks for offering—could you help me log where each repair table and supply box ends up? I’m trying to keep a clear map so nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Opal—I can keep a running list of each table and supply box as they’re set up. Just point me to your map or clipboard and I’ll make sure it stays accurate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m glad I ran into you—there’s a repair drive coming together, and I’m telling everyone on the block so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Quinn. I’m not sure what I can manage right now, but I’ll keep it in mind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fine, Uli—no pressure at all. If you think of anyone with a wobbly chair or busted lamp, just send them my way and I’ll pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—do you have a few minutes to talk through what needs fixing and who might be able to help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’ve got a few minutes. Let’s list the main repairs first, then match people to each one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—let’s start with the urgent ones: the community room lights, the wobbly handrail by the steps, and the leaky faucet in the garden shed. Does that match what you’ve been hearing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane, before we jump in, can you tell me what repairs the drive is covering and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m just getting caught up, so I don’t want to guess. I can check the latest list and get back to you in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate you checking rather than guessing. I’ll wait for the latest list before we decide what to do next.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to work around school pickup and drop-off times—do you know when the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye! I’m not sure yet which time slot is busiest, but I can check with the repair drive organizers and let you know so you can plan around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara, that would be really helpful—if there’s a mid-morning or early afternoon slot, I can probably make that work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive, honestly—what have you heard so far, Jules?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve mostly heard folks are trying to gather tools, spare parts, and a few handy volunteers, but it still sounds a bit scattered. I can check with the garden crew and the library group to see who’s already in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would help a lot, thank you—once you hear back, I can pass the same update along to anyone else who asks me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m a little slammed, but I heard there’s a repair drive happening—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I heard that too, Bo, but I want to confirm before we start asking folks. Did you see an actual notice with the date and what kinds of repairs they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only caught a quick mention, not the actual notice—so I shouldn’t spread details yet. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I see the date or repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much about the repair drive yet, Oren. What kind of help are they looking for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive—last I heard they needed folks who can fix small appliances and bicycles, plus people to help sort parts and make coffee for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds manageable; I’m not much of a fixer, but I could help sort parts or keep coffee going. Do you know when they’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I heard folks are getting a repair drive together—do you know what the plan is so I can help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still getting the details, but I can start a supply list now—tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks. If you spread the word, tell folks to bring anything useful and I’ll note what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Cleo—I’ll tell everyone to bring useful repair supplies, especially tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks, and that you’re keeping the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I’m just back from errands—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, Ira. I haven’t heard the latest yet, but if you know who’s coordinating today I can check in quietly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard either, but I can ask around at the corner store and let you know if anyone mentions who’s coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Vik, remind me—are we collecting tools for the repair drive today, or am I mixing that up with next week?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Oren — that’s today, yes. We’re collecting tools for the repair drive this afternoon, and I’ll help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks, Vik—today it is. I’ll bring over the spare screwdrivers and that little socket set before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Leo, sorry if I missed the latest—what’s the current plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Plan is simple: collect broken small appliances Saturday morning, sort what we can fix, and list parts we need by noon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Saturday morning collection and parts list by noon—I’ll try to be there early, though remind me if I wander off into the wrong task.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I’ve got a few tools I can bring for the repair drive if that’d help—what are folks most likely to need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help, Gus. I’d bring screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench set, and a good extension cord—most folks seem to come in with loose handles, stuck hinges, or small appliance troubles.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’ll pack those up and bring a couple extra bits and clamps too, just in case someone’s got something fiddly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Mara! Could you help me spread the word to the folks on your block and ask who has tools or broken items to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll check in with folks on my block today and ask who can bring tools or items that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I was thinking the repair drive could be a great chance to bring a few circles together—your handy folks, my block group, maybe the community garden crew too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds promising, Jules—I can start mapping who’s where and which groups overlap, so we don’t miss anyone nearby.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be perfect, Opal—if you map the overlaps, I can start reaching out and make sure each group knows where they can plug in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’m glad we could connect about the repair drive—are you thinking more about donations, volunteers, or getting the word out first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’d start with supplies and donations so we know what we’re working with, then we can line up volunteers around the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes perfect sense, Cleo—let’s start a clear supply wish list and note what’s already pledged, then we can recruit volunteers for the missing pieces.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive so far—do you know what still needs help?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still getting the details, Nell. Do you know if they need more tools, volunteers, or just people bringing broken items?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I only heard from someone on Birch Street that they might be short on volunteers. I can ask around and let you know if I get anything clearer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I’m a little swamped, but what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — could you handle the after-school drop-off window, maybe 3 to 5, so families can bring items when they pick up the kids?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can cover 3 to 5 after school for drop-offs. I’ll keep it simple and point folks where to leave things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam—but before I count you in, can you confirm you’re actually free this Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m free this Saturday morning, so you can count me in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Dane, I heard there’s some kind of repair drive getting organized, but I’m still catching up—do you know what folks actually need help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m catching up too, Nell, but from what I’ve heard it’s mostly small appliance fixes, loose bike brakes, and a few screen doors that need patching.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—thanks. I’ll ask around and see if anyone has spare tools or parts for those, especially bike cables and screen patches.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—what still needs sorting first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Mara—first I want to pin down where each repair station will be set up, then match the tools and volunteers to those spots.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds like the right order—let’s map the stations first, and I can help note which tools and volunteers each one needs as we go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I’m starting a quick list for the repair drive—do we know what supplies people need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’ve heard batteries and tarps, but can you confirm with Mara or the block chat before we write that down?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’ll check with Mara and the block chat first, then I’ll update the list with whatever they confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put you on the invite list or pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Quinn, put me on the invite list—I'd like to hear the details and I can mention it while I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Ira—I’ll add you to the invite list and send over the details. Thanks for helping spread the word while you’re out!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Pia, what repairs are we collecting for the drive, and when do you need them dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Leo—let’s stick to small appliance and bike repairs for now, nothing bulky. Could folks drop them off by Friday evening so we have time to sort everything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—small appliances and bikes only, drop-off by Friday evening. I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—this feels like something a lot of different neighbors could rally around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so too, Jules. Before we start asking people, can we pin down exactly what kinds of repairs we’re collecting for and who will handle them?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, let’s keep it focused: small appliance fixes, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups, then we can ask Sam’s tool crew, Priya’s sewing circle, and Marco’s cyclists who can take each lane.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, I’m glad we could connect about the repair drive— I’d love to hear what you think we should prioritize first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Rosa. I’d start by asking a few neighbors what’s breaking most often, then prioritize the repairs that affect safety or daily needs first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes good sense, Rey—I'll put together a quick neighbor check-in list and make sure safety and daily essentials are at the top.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Uli, have you heard how the repair drive is coming along? I was just wondering who’s bringing what and whether they still need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Tess. I can ask around quietly, and if they still need hands, I can help for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Uli—if you hear who’s coordinating it, let me know and I’ll spread the word without making too much fuss.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the list in front of me yet, Mina, so I’d rather not guess. Let’s check the sign-up sheet and make a clear rundown of what’s broken and who’s covered each job.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine, let’s pull up the sign-up sheet now and sort it by repair type so we can see the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, I caught bits and pieces about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo—could you help spread the word and maybe bring any tools or small items that need fixing? We’re trying to get a good mix of volunteers and neighbors who need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can mention it to folks on my block and dig around for a couple tools or busted odds and ends to bring by.
